as_told.title: Randy Anderson: off-world technology under NSWC Crane
as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

plain: Randy Anderson, who says he served as an Army weapons sergeant (a job he calls 18 Bravo), says that around 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane in Indiana he was taken to another building and down an elevator, deep underground, through a security checkpoint into a space far more modern than anything above ground, where he saw a levitating orb and a gauntlet giving off holographic, hieroglyph-like symbols that looked "almost like a mirage." He tells this first-hand to Michels on two episodes, and Michels repeats it on many others, at one point naming his DD214 (his military discharge record) and an "Off-World Technologies" division. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb adds that Anderson was told the technology was classed as a weapon because it gave off an electric discharge when it was recovered, and if true, the story would mean the military holds technology it believes was not made by humans.
